Julio,

 

The specimen names of a geomorph object may be found using ‘dimnames()’.  Since the default is a 3D array, the names of the third dimension correspond with the specimens. 

 

To change these, simply create a vector with new names and replace them once read into R.  An example is below.


Dean

 

###

library(geomorph)

data("scallops")

 

dim(scallops$coorddata)

dimnames(scallops$coorddata)

 

newnames <- c("A","B","C","D", "E")

dimnames(scallops$coorddata)[[3]] <- newnames

 

dimnames(scallops$coorddata)
